visualCharacteristics.structure: One row per village (6). Cell 1 (label): village name + location (e.g. "Sherwood Forest / Nottinghamshire, UK"). Cell 2 (panel): image, H3 village name, location paragraph, description, CTA link "Discover Sherwood Forest".
visualCharacteristics.notes: Interactive selector: choosing a village pin on the map swaps the visible village card. Equivalent to labelled switchable panels - tabs is the closest library match (one tab per village). The map illustration is a decorative background handled in CSS. Section style: green.
